title: A live wild Gastly completes one natural Teleport

verification.actor: WILD species 92 (Gastly), acquired through spawn; live handle and attached presentation required
verification.trigger: Leave the same live Wild Gastly on neutral input until its normal planner completes one authored Teleport
verification.observable: One Teleport starts, advances its path, commits once at the target, finishes, releases its reservation, and returns control

setupMutations.change: Disposable test.sav, checked teleport to map33, native Gastly spawn at (583,406), exact identity bind, and an idle wait. Do not change the behavior profile, planner, input, timing, path, or actor state during observation.

limits: Prepared spawning does not prove natural population spawning.
One natural authored nine-frame Teleport does not prove the separate fixed/per-tile visibility matrix.
Registration alone is not runtime acceptance; the checked shared test must pass on the current ROM.

events.value: Spawn and bind Wild Gastly at map33 (583,406), then wait until it is idle
Keep input neutral and retain one normal Teleport from start through control return

stop.condition: The selected Gastly completes one Teleport and returns idle

invariants: Each accepted motion has exactly one terminal result
No logical commit occurs after motion cancellation
Control returns after the selected motion finishes or cancels
No active actors share a nonzero target reservation
Every active actor handle uses the current field epoch
Every active actor has an attached presentation
Every path advance is ordered before the terminal logical commit
